title: Usage analytics observability playbook and dynamic alert tuning
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create an operational playbook and implement dynamic alert tuning for the Console usage analytics pipelines. The goal is to reduce alert noise, surface real customer-impacting regressions in ingestion and query latency, and provide clear runbooks for on-call responders. This ticket covers: (1) defining baseline SLIs/SLOs for ingestion, transform, and query layers; (2) implementing dynamic thresholding and anomaly detection for high-cardinality metrics (per-tenant ingest rate, kv-cache hit ratio, pipeline lag); (3) updating Grafana dashboards and adding focused incident runbooks; (4) deploying sampling changes to maintain observability cost budgets while preserving signal for high-impact tenants.
acceptance_criteria: Baseline SLI definitions documented and reviewed by PM and SRE
Dynamic alerting prototype (ML-based or percentile windows) running against last-90d metrics and reducing false positives by >= 40% in initial eval
Per-route Grafana dashboard templates created with drilldowns for tenant-scoped views
Runbooks added to Confluence with clear escalation paths and post-incident checklist
Sampling configuration implemented so observability costs remain within the agreed budget during a 2-week smoke test
success_metrics: Alert volume (pager+ticket) down 40% for analytics ingestion alerts compared to baseline
Mean time to acknowledge (MTTA) for priority analytics incidents under 10 minutes
High-impact customer incidents detected pre-EScalation in >90% of cases during the test window
Observability spend for analytics telemetry within 10% of current budget after sampling changes
updates: 2025-02-12 - Ticket created. Initial scope drafted with PM to prioritize ingestion and query latency signals.

2025-02-18 - Spike completed: evaluated three dynamic thresholding approaches (rolling-percentile, EWMA-based, and an isolation forest anomaly model). Rolling-percentile is simplest and lowest-cost; isolation forest shows promise for complex multi-variate anomalies.
2025-02-24 - Decision: implement rolling-percentile for per-tenant ingest rate and EWMA for kv-cache hit ratio; schedule isolation-forest proof-of-concept for exploratory work in next cycle.

2025-02-28 - Grafana dashboard templates sketched; created tenant drilldown panels and latency heatmap. Link to draft dashboard: https://grafana.redwood-internal.com/d/analytics/usage-observability-template
2025-03-01 - Confluence playbook skeleton created with escalation steps and triage checklist: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Usage+Analytics+Playbook
2025-03-03 - Instrumentation change merged (GH PR #1624) to emit per-route ingest buckets and error-category tags. Need one follow-up to add tagging for cached vs. cold-start responses.
2025-03-03 - Next: implement alert rules in prod-staging, run 2-week A/B test of rolling-percentile rules vs. static thresholds, measure false positive rate and MTTA.
Notes: Coordinate with CostOps on sampling targets; inform customer success of upcoming tenant-level alerting to avoid surprising customers.
